_about: HAND PRIORS for the bingo64 cost model. All times are integer DECISECONDS (600 = 1 minute). Every number here is a GUESS, to be replaced by fit.py from votes. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Courses use the dump abbreviations (BOB..RR, BitDW..SA) plus 'Castle' (the hub, always visited, V=0).

V._why: Cost of visiting a course once: walk from wherever you are in the castle to the painting + star select + load (the 'travel' part, ~12-45 s by floor) + ~25-35 s of getting oriented / moving around (the 'roam' part; 10 s for the tiny secret courses). Bowser courses include the full obstacle-course traversal (60/90/120 s), because every tile there needs it. Stars exit the course in vanilla, so a SECOND star in the same course pays params.reentry, not V.

_reentry_why: Every star after the first in the same course: star dance, exit, walk back into the painting, star select (~12 s). GUESS.

star._why: Work for one star once you are in the course. Main-course stars 1-6 = starTimes[] from bingo_const.c (RTA-ish seconds, the same table STAR_TIMED uses) x scale_pct. The 100-coin star = the coin-tier cost of 100 coins in that course + hundred_extra. Special-course stars are flat guesses. 'B' = the Bowser fight (not a star; does not count toward star totals).

overrides._why: 1-based 'COURSE:STAR' -> deciseconds; beats the starTimes rule. Empty until Matt disagrees with a star.

modifiers._why: Challenge stars cost star work x pct/100 (retries, slower movement). STAR_TIMED: base pct, plus per_s_pct for every second of slack below tight_s (slack = limit - starTimes). CLICK_GAME: +tight_pct when at most 1 click is allowed. DAREDEVIL on a 100-coin star uses hundred_pct. All GUESSES; the A-button number is the least certain.

u._why: Marginal cost of one more unit of a global counter once you are already in a course that has it (walk over + kill/collect). Units past counter_tail.pct of a course's supply cost x counter_tail.mult (the last few are the far-flung ones). GUESSES scaled from how spread out each thing is.

f._why: Free units per visit: things you kill/collect anyway while in the course for something else = pct% of that course's supply, capped. Deliberate actions (getting hurt, dying, shooting cannons, losing the hat) are never free (pct 0). The hub gives nothing free. GUESS: the plan's '~30% of supply'.

overrides._why: TYPE -> {course: free units}, beats the pct rule. Example knob; empty by default.

coins._why: Coins are per-entry (the HUD count resets on exit). free_per_visit coins come with any visit, +free_with_star if a star run shares the entry. u per coin; coins past tier1_pct of the course's total cost x tier2_mult, past tier2_pct x tier3_mult (the last coins are the hard ones). MULTICOIN farms with the same curve in visited courses (or opens new ones). Every 50 coins in one entry is a 1-up.

oneups._why: 1-ups: free_pct of a course's 1-ups come free per visit; the rest cost u each (tail_mult for the last 30%). The castle grounds' 9 cost castle_u each. Lives start at start_lives; every death costs one (LIVES vs UNIQUE_DEATHS anti-synergy).

blj._why: BLJ in N unique courses: per visited course cost (walk to stairs/slope, do it). GUESS.

dwk._why: K perilous wall kicks in each of N courses: per course base + per kick. GUESS.

splatoon._why: Inking: per floor tile, minus free_pct% of the course's floors per visit and per star entry. GUESS (TTM's 1501 tiles are small).

purple._why: 3 random purple stars: per star, a traversal to a random spot. GUESS.

roof._why: Reach the castle roof without the cannon (hub work). GUESS.
